# Project Overview

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Purpose

Single-screen guided-practice bench for system-design interviews: pick a seeded problem statement, run a phase-weighted countdown, draw the architecture from a closed component vocabulary, tick a per-phase checklist and run capacity estimates — all persisted per user (`README.md` intro, `app/Http/Controllers/BoardController.php`).

### Business problem

- No place to rehearse the interview ritual end to end — statement, clock, script, drawing — without stitching together a timer, a doc and a generic diagram tool.
- Generic diagram editors offer an open vocabulary; the closed 28-component palette seeded in `database/seeders/ComponentSeeder.php` is what forces interview-shaped choices.
- Practice state used to die with the browser tab. `training_sessions` (migration `2026_08_22_210054_create_training_sessions_table.php`) makes a drill resumable from any machine, scoped to its owner.
- Capacity math is where candidates freeze; `resources/js/prancheta/estimate.ts` computes 10 output rows from 2 input modes and prints a conclusion keyed off peak QPS (`HEAVY_PEAK_QPS = 50000`, `MODERATE_PEAK_QPS = 5000`).
- The app deliberately does not grade the drawing: no score, no reviewer, no AI judge (`README.md`; `tests/Feature/Sessions/NoDiagramEvaluationTest.php`).

### Consumers and integrations

| System | Role |
| --- | --- |
| Browser (Inertia v3 + Vue 3 SPA) | Only client. Boots via `resources/js/app.ts`, renders `resources/js/pages/Board.vue` from `Inertia::render('Board', …)`. |
| `resources/js/lib/sessionTransport.ts` | First-party JSON client for `/api/sessions*`; rides Inertia's HTTP client so the session cookie and `X-XSRF-TOKEN` travel — there is no API token. |
| Laravel Fortify (`laravel/fortify ^1.37.2`) | Headless auth: registration, email verification, 2FA, passkeys. `config/fortify.php` line 166 keeps `Features::resetPasswords()` commented out. |
| `@laravel/passkeys ^0.2.0` | WebAuthn browser client for the Fortify passkey routes (`passkeys/login`, `user/passkeys`). |
| MySQL 8 (dev/prod) | Sole datastore: catalog tables + `training_sessions` + framework session/cache tables (`docker-compose.yml`, `.env.example` `DB_CONNECTION=mysql`). |
| Mailer | `MAIL_MAILER=log` in `.env.example`; used only by Fortify email verification. |
| Laravel Wayfinder (`laravel/wayfinder ^0.1.14`) | Build-time generator of typed TS route/action helpers consumed by `sessionTransport.ts`. |

### Macro flow

1. `GET /prancheta` hits `BoardController::__invoke` behind the `auth` middleware (`routes/web.php`).
2. `CurrentSessionResolver::resolve()` returns the user's session with the highest `last_opened_at`; when the user has none, `SessionCreator::create()` mints an empty one (45 min, `show_connection_order` `true`, `DEFAULT_ESTIMATE`).
3. `CatalogService::payload($session)` assembles 6 catalog collections (problems, component categories with nested components, link types, phases with checklist items, session durations, estimate modes) — active rows plus whatever the loaded session still references.
4. `Inertia::render('Board', ['session' => …, 'catalog' => …])` ships both in one response; the clock always arrives paused (only `elapsed_seconds` travels — the server has no "running" state).
5. `resources/js/pages/Board.vue` hydrates `CanvasEngine` (`resources/js/canvas/engine.ts`) and the `SessionStore` (`resources/js/prancheta/session.ts`).
6. Every edit marks the store dirty (signature-derived, `resources/js/prancheta/session.ts`) and calls `Autosave.touch()`: 800 ms debounce to `localStorage`, 3 s debounce to the server, 15 s ceiling (`resources/js/prancheta/autosave.ts`).
7. `PUT /api/sessions/{trainingSession}` validates via `TrainingSessionUpdateRequest` (200 nodes / 400 edges / 60-char labels / 5000-char notes) and `SessionStateWriter::write()` saves diagram JSON + own columns in one `DB::transaction`.
8. Response is `{"id": …, "updated_at": …}`; the client marks the signature saved. Terminal state: one row in `training_sessions` holding the whole drill.
9. Side branch: `resources/js/canvas/svg.ts` + `resources/js/prancheta/export.ts` + `resources/js/lib/downloadFile.ts` produce an SVG file client-side — the server is not involved.

### Out of scope

Explicit v1 boundaries recorded in `README.md` ("Fora do v1") and locked by `tests/Feature/DeliveryContractTest.php:134`:

- Presentation mode (stepping through the diagram for an audience).
- Starter templates (opening a session with a pre-drawn skeleton).
- Cross-session history / side-by-side comparison.
- Autolayout — block placement is always manual.
- BFF layer — Inertia talks straight to Laravel.
- Redis — no cache tier and no queue; writes are synchronous.
- Password recovery — `Features::resetPasswords()` stays commented out in `config/fortify.php`.
